name: Bullock Cart
summary: Indian-style wooden bullock cart with spoked wheels and a curved canopy, pulled by an ox by default; animal can be off.

params.name: x
params.note: centre x of the whole cart and ox at frame 0

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the wheels and the hooves stand on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: about 1000 px wide and 620 px tall at s = 1

params.name: animal
params.note: draw the flat-vector/ox pulling the cart; false = the cart alone

params.name: anim
params.note: drive = spokes turn, cart bounces and the ox walks (also on when vx is not 0)

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the ox and tongue face left

author: krakujs
